cases.case_label: 4.9-kb SVA/L1 composite insertion in HCFC1 3' UTR (VUS)
cases.mechanism_detail: A maternally inherited 4,902-bp insertion of SVA and L1 sequence (79-nt polyA) found by HiFi sequencing lengthens the HCFC1 3' UTR ~3.75-fold; 3'-end RNA-seq showed ~8.8-fold lower HCFC1 expression in the proband than his father, but the variant was classified as a VUS.
cases.quote: While these results are consistent with the hypothesis that the insertion has a large effect on HCFC1 expression and potential activity, they are not definitive.
